modeling_decisions: Concept inspected: descending continuous corkscrew, open coil gaps and lower lateral chamber adopted. Top concept incorrectly shows a hollow entry despite solid-cast prompt. Resolve before modeling: cap entry with solid sediment end, no hollow-bore claim. Freeze4.5 helical turns with natural small radius and pitch variation, continuous terminal tube blending into modest elongated closed chamber and short top entry neck. Small irregular sediment footing supports lower tunnel, not obscuring upper coil negative spaces. Exact coil count, chamber outline, exposure, scale and color illustrative; source supports spiral burrow cast and bottom chamber, not measured here.
